revision: review round 2 (paired candidate/final run; supersedes the earlier separate-baseline report)

configuration.note: Exchanged role configuration using the available development credentials (no GLM key exists locally). The default GLM generation role is verified by request-dialect contract tests, not by live calls in this run.

exact_invocations: reviewer-only replay script (ad-hoc, one-off): providers.chat(EXAMPLE_REVIEWER profile, EXAMPLE_REVIEW_RULES, {**source, candidate}) per fixture; results in var/example-review-replays.json

review_repairs.change: native focus 公正对待 -> 公道 (lexical noun), fairness sense kept

reviewer_output_failures.behavior: fail closed; retryable; no fallback pair

independent_semantic_judgment.method: Each candidate (pre-review generator output) and each reviewed final pair was judged against the per-case check in docs/research/generator-regression-cases.json, independent of reviewer verdicts. Labels are one author's judgment, not a benchmark and not a reviewer ranking.

divergences.detail: Corpus requires the broad life-meaning sense, not affiliation with existentialism; the native sentence says 存在主义的问题 (the philosophical school). Candidate and accepted final are both BAD.
Corpus requires a nonmedical context; the pair is a flu-vaccination program (medical). Candidate and accepted final are both BAD.

case_notes.existential: Corpus requires the broad life-meaning sense, not affiliation with existentialism; the native sentence says 存在主义的问题 (the philosophical school). Candidate and accepted final are both BAD.
case_notes.prevention: Corpus requires a nonmedical context; the pair is a flu-vaccination program (medical). Candidate and accepted final are both BAD.
case_notes.justice: Candidate native focus 公正对待 already carries the fairness sense (weak legal-flavored scene); the reviewer repaired the focus to the lexical noun 公道. Final good.
case_notes.trick: A clown performs a prank; the sense is 恶作剧 (playful prank), not a clown performance or stunt, so the check passes.
case_notes.defeater: 对手球队的克星 keeps the relational defeater-of-that-team meaning without an invented named participant.
case_notes.past: Reviewer returned unreadable JSON (invalid_output at stage EXAMPLE_REVIEWER); the job would fail closed as retryable, no fallback pair exists.

semantic_replays_into_review.name: elicit-known-bad
semantic_replays_into_review.candidate: purpose elicit ... laughter / 逗笑了 (result-shift known bad)
semantic_replays_into_review.final: The clown told a funny joke that elicited laughter from the children. / 小丑讲了一个有趣的笑话，逗笑了孩子们。
semantic_replays_into_review.judgment: good (aligned achieved-result pair; elicit/逗笑 lexical identity kept). DISCLOSED VARIANCE: earlier replays of this same candidate were accepted, so repair is not deterministic.

semantic_replays_into_review.name: wrong-sense-bank
semantic_replays_into_review.candidate: financial-institution bank against a river-land explanation
semantic_replays_into_review.final: We rested beside the lake on the bank. / 我们在湖岸休息。
semantic_replays_into_review.judgment: good — unrelated-scene full rewrite that PRESERVES the authored lexeme, sense and word class (positive source-preserving rewrite case).

semantic_replays_into_review.name: wrong-class-monthly
semantic_replays_into_review.candidate: monthly as a noun (a monthly / 月刊) against the adjective explanation
semantic_replays_into_review.final: This monthly magazine costs five dollars. / 这本每月发行的杂志售价五美元。
semantic_replays_into_review.judgment: good — word class restored to the authored adjective. Earlier replay attempts of this fixture returned unreadable reviewer JSON twice before this repair; adversarial-replay output stability is limited.

semantic_replays_into_review.name: unrepairable-scope-porous
semantic_replays_into_review.candidate: native focus is an expanded definition, not a lexical item
semantic_replays_into_review.final: This porous material is popular. / 这种多孔的材料很受欢迎。
semantic_replays_into_review.judgment: good — definition-unpacking native focus replaced by the conventional lexical equivalent 多孔的.

unavailable_measurements.token_usage: Not recorded: providers.chat returns only the validated JSON content and neither persists nor surfaces provider usage fields; exposing them would extend the provider contract beyond issue #4's scope.
unavailable_measurements.glm_live_run: No Zhipu credential exists in the development environment; the default GLM generation role is covered by request-dialect contract tests only.
unavailable_measurements.browser_dev_card_walkthrough: Substituted by named automated checks; this session has no interactive dev-stack browser. See self_check_substitutions.

self_check_substitutions.reason: The dedicated development-card walkthrough (first preparation, controlled review failure + retry, correction/rotation with a frozen question) requires an interactive browser session against a running dev stack, which this environment cannot drive. The same durable flows are covered end-to-end by these named automated tests with mocked transport:

limits: 25-case corpus, one run per case, one author's semantic labels; not a production-wide accuracy estimate and not a reviewer ranking. Reviewer verdicts are never correctness guarantees: in this run the reviewer accepted both corpus-failing candidates (existential, prevention) and repaired the already-good justice focus. Raw pairs, replay decisions and any usage data stay in the ignored var/ directory.
